in_marathi.name: Sheena
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of the Moon
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sheena हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sheena is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Chhaya' which means 'shadow' or 'reflection'. In Hindu mythology, Sheena is believed to be the goddess of the moon and the embodiment of beauty, grace, and light. She is also associated with the cycle of life, rebirth, and transformation.
